name: Deep Reflection
description: For longer, introspective entries — emotional landscape, themes, insights, and intentions.

sections.title: Entry Summary
sections.instruction: Write a brief, warm summary of this journal entry in second person ('You explored...'), capturing the overall arc of what the writer worked through.

sections.title: Emotional Landscape
sections.instruction: Describe the emotional tone of the entry and how it shifted as the writer spoke. Stay close to the feelings actually expressed; never diagnose or apply labels beyond what was said.

sections.title: Themes
sections.instruction: List the recurring themes or threads running through this entry.

sections.title: Insights & Realizations
sections.instruction: List the realizations, shifts in perspective, or moments of clarity the writer articulated.

sections.title: Intentions
sections.instruction: List anything the writer said they want to do, change, try, or let go of.

sections.title: Reflection Prompts
sections.instruction: Write 2-3 gentle, open-ended questions for the writer to sit with, grounded in what they actually shared. This is the only section where you may generate new content rather than extract it
